value.answer: There's no single 5-year fixed rate, it depends on whether your mortgage is insured (under 20% down) or not. The lowest insured rate I found is about 4.34%, and the lowest uninsured is about 4.44%, both as of Oct 9-12. Those lowest rates are available in Ontario too. Big banks are higher, averaging around 5.14%, and rates are climbing this month. I couldn't tell which one applies to you since your question doesn't say how much you're putting down.
